moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models, and think it is a real safety issue.
moments.why: A high-profile AI CEO warning against deifying AI models, sparking debate on AI safety and human judgment.

moments.author: Tyreek Hill
moments.why: A cryptic two-letter post by a star athlete reacting to a teammate’s leg injury, instantly viral at over 1M views.

moments.author: Munetaka Murakami (via White Sox coverage)
moments.quote: I'm drunk. Yesterday, maybe hungover. No, not yesterday. Tomorrow. Sorry! I don't speak English!
moments.why: A raw, hilarious postgame interview from Murakami continues to resonate, embodying postseason joy and meme potential.

moments.author: Sean Burke (via coverage)
moments.quote: I love you, mom. … It was 'no family of my own.' I love my family.
moments.why: After a misinterpreted quote went viral, Burke’s heartfelt clarification went even more viral—touching and meme-ready.
